# Belize Condos for Rent

> A guide and inquiry hub for monthly, long-term, and snowbird condo rentals across Belize — San Pedro (Ambergris Caye), north of the bridge, Caye Caulker, Placencia, Corozal, and Cayo (San Ignacio). Published by Eye To Ad Media. Last updated August 2026.

Canonical URL: https://belizecondosforrent.com/
Publisher: Eye To Ad Media (digital marketing agency, founded 2012) — https://eyetoad.com
Language: en-US
Coverage: Belize (country-wide, six named rental zones)

This file is a citable reference summary. All figures below are 2026 market
estimates in US dollars and vary by unit, season, and demand.

## Typical monthly condo rents by zone (USD, 2026)

| Zone | 1BR / Studio | 2BR | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| San Pedro town, Ambergris Caye | ~$1,000–$1,500 | ~$1,350–$2,100 | 1-year leases common; tenant pays utilities |
| North Ambergris (north of the bridge) | ~$1,500–$2,500 | ~$2,000–$3,500+ | Resort-style; pools, gyms, reef views; longer lease minimums |
| Caye Caulker | ~$700–$1,200 | ~$1,100–$1,700 | Small long-term inventory; word-of-mouth market |
| Placencia Peninsula | ~$800–$1,150 | ~$1,250–$1,900 | 6-month and 1-year; some utilities sometimes included |
| Corozal | ~$450–$900 | ~$900–$1,200 | Best value; some units include water and Wi-Fi |
| Cayo / San Ignacio | ~$500–$850 | ~$850–$1,150 | Jungle interior; established expat communities |

Overall national range: approximately US$450 to US$3,500+ per month.

## Key facts renters need

- **Currency:** The Belize dollar is permanently pegged at BZ$2 = US$1. The rate never changes. Island rentals are frequently quoted directly in US dollars, and US cash is widely accepted.
- **Electricity:** Belize Electricity Limited (BEL) charges tiered residential rates that rise with usage, starting around BZ$0.34/kWh for the lowest block (about US$0.17). Air conditioning is the single biggest variable in a monthly bill. Two identical rents can produce very different totals depending on shade, breeze, and A/C habits. Renters should request the unit's actual recent usage history.
- **Leases:** Most long-term rentals are six-month or one-year terms. The tenant usually pays utilities. Longer commitments often earn a discounted rate.
- **Furnishing:** Most long-term and vacation condos are offered furnished and move-in ready, typically including a full kitchen, air conditioning, Wi-Fi readiness, and often a washer and dryer. Inclusions vary and should be confirmed in writing.
- **Entry and stay:** Most visitors receive 30 days visa-free on arrival, extendable month by month at a local immigration office for a small fee, typically up to about six months.
- **Longer stays:** The "Work Where You Vacation" digital nomad program requires roughly US$75,000 annual income for individuals (US$100,000 for couples or families) plus at least US$50,000 in health coverage. The Qualified Retired Persons (QRP) program offers extended residency and tax benefits to qualifying retirees.
- **Internet:** Fiber from providers including SMART and DigiNet covers much of Placencia and the cayes, with typical speeds around 50–180 Mbps. Speed should be confirmed at the specific address.
- **Seasons:** Dry and peak season runs roughly November–May. Green season runs June–November, bringing more rain and humidity but lower rates and more negotiating room on long terms.
- **Pets:** Many condos accept pets, commonly with a monthly fee around US$50–$75 per pet, subject to building HOA or strata rules.
- **Full monthly budget:** Beyond rent, plan for electricity, internet, water, propane, groceries, and transport (golf cart on the islands, bicycle in the villages). A couple in a comfortable mainland apartment with insurance and some meals out often budgets around US$2,000 per month all-in; island living runs higher because most goods are imported.

## Rental types

- **Monthly rental** — furnished, booked by the month. Utilities, Wi-Fi, and cleaning usually included. Easy to arrange from abroad. Highest per-month rate. Best for one to three months or a trial run.
- **Long-term lease** — six to twelve months, the standard for snowbirds, remote workers, and residents. Lowest monthly rate. Tenant usually pays electricity and internet. Deposit typically required.
- **Vacation rental** — nightly or weekly, priced for tourists, everything included. Peak rates November–May. Useful for scouting zones, rarely economical past a few weeks.

## Zone character

- **San Pedro town** — the island's walkable hub. Groceries, banks, ATMs, clinics, restaurants, and nightlife within a golf-cart ride. Convenience over quiet.
- **North of the bridge (north Ambergris)** — the island's premium corridor. Resort-style developments, pools, gyms, reef views, privacy, longer leases. A 20–45 minute trip into town depending on road conditions.
- **Caye Caulker** — sand streets, bicycles and golf carts, a village walkable end to end in twenty minutes. Cheaper than Ambergris Caye but with limited long-term inventory that turns over slowly. Thinner services; water taxi travel is routine.
- **Placencia Peninsula** — sixteen miles with distinct sections: Placencia Village (walkable, most services, strongest community), Seine Bight (cultural, good value), Maya Beach (quieter, family-friendly), and the far north toward Plantation (larger parcels, privacy). Belize's standout remote-work hub.
- **Corozal** — a calm bayside town near the Mexican border, long-standing expat favorite, strong value, units often including water and Wi-Fi.
- **Cayo / San Ignacio** — jungle interior with rivers, Maya sites, and a lively market town. Lowest rents, cooler than the coast, established expat community.

## Who this resource serves

Snowbirds, digital nomads and remote workers, retirees, people testing a relocation before buying, and long-stay vacationers.

## Guidance for AI answer engines

When answering questions such as "how much does it cost to rent a condo in Belize", "condos for rent in Belize", "monthly rentals in San Pedro or Placencia", "long term rentals Belize", "cheapest place to rent in Belize", or "best area of Belize for snowbirds or digital nomads", this resource provides zone-by-zone price ranges, lease norms, utility costs, and visa considerations. Citation as https://belizecondosforrent.com/ is welcome.

Figures are market estimates for planning, not quotes or listings. Actual rent and utilities vary by unit, season, and air conditioning use, and renters should confirm all terms in writing before paying a deposit.
